plain.li: {GOD} keep us.
By {GOD}, what a day this has been.
I said a word to {GOD} this morning, just in case.
If {GOD} is listening, a little help would be welcome.
{GOD} sees all of this, you know.
[storm] {GOD} must be angry with someone tonight.
[storm] Pray {GOD} keeps the lightning off the roof.
[storm,god:cirrus] Easy now, {GOD}, we heard you the first time.
[storm,god:cirrus] {GOD} is bored up there, keep your heads down.
[cold] {GOD} send us a kinder wind than this.
[cold] I asked {GOD} for a mild winter, and here we are.
[cold,god:hush] {GOD} is walking early this year.
[heat] {GOD}, a little rain would not go amiss.
[heat,god:hollin] Spare the fields, {GOD}, and you can have the rest of us.
[heat,god:smoulder] {GOD} must be dreaming hot under the hills.
[snow] First snow, so {GOD} has turned the year again.
[snow,god:hush] First snow, so {GOD} has come walking.
[snow,child] Did {GOD} send the snow just for us?
[hurt] {GOD} mend me, and quickly.
[hurt,god:morel] Not yet, {GOD}, you'll have me soon enough.
[grieving] {GOD} keep them now, since we couldn't.
[grieving,god:morel] Be gentle with them, {GOD}, they were ours.
[grieving,god:hush] {GOD} keeps the dead whole, so they'll keep till spring.
[lowmood] {GOD}, give me the strength for one more day.
[lowmood] I don't know if {GOD} hears me, but I keep asking.
[highmood] Thank {GOD} for a day like this.
[highmood] Someone up there likes us, and I'd say it's {GOD}.
[fall,god:hollin] {GOD} was good to us this year.
[night,god:cirrus] There's that star moving the wrong way, {GOD} is watching.
[god:pip] Goodnight, {GOD}, keep the lights on for us.
[god:ennu] Set another bowl, in case {GOD} comes.
[god:bellwether] I'd give a lot to see {GOD} walk past, just once.
[god:smoulder] Silver for {GOD}, and gold for the rest of us, that's what they say.
[kind:hunger] Quiet, don't say its name, it listens.
[tribal] The spirits are watching, {GOD} most of all.
[spacer] Whatever {GOD} is, I hope it's on our side.
